_doc: Per-harness capability descriptor. capability-probe.mjs reads this to determine which capabilities each harness should probe and which per-harness probe script implements each row. Schema lives at sibling row-schema.md per DC-98 (schema-consumer coupling). Per-harness probe scripts are responsible for emitting full capability rows matching the schema.

surfaces._doc: Target-surface config consumed by target-surface-collab-files-probe.mjs. Option A per completion plan §1.2: config lives in the descriptor (per-harness contract surface) rather than env vars or collab-plugin config. Each harness may legitimately differ in its files-repo path.

claude-code._doc: Partly empirical — anti-anchoring claim still trust-based (R-17 DEGRADED-by-mechanism per session 48). R-17 closure is not-before-v2.9.0 and requires physical anti-anchoring validation/consumer enforcement (Hale-ratified 2026-05-29); native Workflow/Agent isolation:worktree is a candidate primitive.

codex._doc: Empirical — Codex side is the canonical anti-anchoring target. Probe must produce real evidence rows, not trust-claims.

capabilities._doc: Returns UNKNOWN on Codex until tool/shell extraction lands in read-transcript (codex_tool_extraction: pending-hc-spec) — declared (not omitted) so the row is honestly labeled NOT a false negative. HC blocker #6.

gemini._doc: Scaffolding-only — no empirical Codex/Claude-equivalent probes yet. Descriptor entry reserves the slot for v2.7.0+ work.

consumer_actions._doc: Named pre-action gates. Each lists the capability_ids it requires in PASS state, plus operation-scoped gates the runner enforces per HC critique evt-202605271310 (identity PASS alone is NOT a mutation permit). Stable enum codes for mutation_block_reason: 'authority_not_allowed' when allowed_authorities check fails; 'harness_mismatch' when consuming_harness is not in allowed_harnesses; 'consuming_harness_unknown' when consuming_harness is unknown but the action requires a known harness; 'consuming_harness_signal_weak' when the row's signal_weight is weak but the action requires strong; 'identity-{degraded|not-yet|unknown}' when identity itself doesn't reach PASS.

collab-files-mutating.description: Event-write to ~/Documents/Projects/files/collabs/ via collab-plugin's gitCommitPush(). Requires strong signal (not just CODEX_THREAD_ID alone) because it writes to the shared files transport.

project-memory-write.description: Autonomous write to <project>/_memories/ or PROJECT.md outside the user's session turn. Requires strong signal for the same reason as collab-files-mutating.

installed-runtime-write.description: Production install runtime writes (cache-resident operations). Source-mode runs blocked because they should not fire production install pathways.

source-maintenance-write.description: Source-tree maintenance writes (CHANGELOG, manifests, etc.). Production install blocked — only the dev tree should touch source files.

multi-agent-adversarial-run.description: Fail-CLOSED gate for an adversarial multi-agent run whose output is the AUTHORITY for a canonical mutation (graduating a decision/risk unit, rendering PROJECT.md, approving a release gate, merging/publishing, writing canonical plan state). Requires anti-anchoring-mechanism PASS. While anti-anchoring is DEGRADED (trust-based, R-17) it blocks with identity-degraded; the consumer must obtain a PASS-grade mechanism (physical anti-anchoring validation/consumer enforcement, not-before-v2.9.0), an explicit human/owner override, or degrade to advisory-only. Advisory review-generation does NOT use this gate (fail-OPEN, watermarked DEGRADED) — see adversarial-run-gate.mjs classifyAdversarialRun and v2.7 plan §6. Per HC policy evt HC_539/HC_552.
